description: Search one of Tabflows' US practice directories: dpc (DPC Finder), concierge-medicine (Concierge Medicine Finder), direct-specialty-care (Direct Specialty Care Finder), functional-medicine (Functional & Longevity Medicine Finder), hormone-clinic (Hormone & Men's Health Clinic Finder), menopause-clinic (Women's Health & Menopause Clinic Finder), weight-loss-clinic (Weight Loss Clinic Finder), med-spa (Med Spa Finder), plastic-surgeon (Plastic Surgeon Finder), cash-pay-physical-therapy (Cash-Pay Physical Therapy Finder), mental-health-practice (Mental Health Practice Finder), dental-membership-plan (Dental Membership Plan Finder), chiropractic-wellness-plan (Chiropractic Wellness Plan Finder). Botox and aesthetics are med-spa, GLP-1 and semaglutide weight-loss-clinic, TRT hormone-clinic, HRT menopause-clinic or hormone-clinic, therapists and psychiatrists mental-health-practice. query takes a practice's name or the whole request in plain words ("a DPC doctor in Denver who sees kids"). state, city and near (a ZIP code) set the place instead, and the query is then read as words only. Results are ranked, nearest first around a place, and each carries an id for get_business_directory_listing and the tabflows.com page that lists it. Pass nextCursor back as cursor, with the same search, for the next page.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page of the same search

near.description: A five-digit ZIP code: listings within 25 miles, nearest first

query.description: A practice name, a place, or the request in plain words, e.g. "direct primary care in Denver for my family"

name: search_business_directory_listings
title: Search a Tabflows directory
